projects.name: Newton Power Plant Coal to Solar & Energy Storage project
projects.quote: Mobilizing for construction on our third Illinois Coal to Solar & • Energy Storage Initiative project at our Newton Power Plant; the solar-plus-storage facility will total 52 MW.
